designationHistory.indexText: Congress established the Kanuti National Wildlife Refuge, about 1.43 million acres of public land in interior Alaska, in the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act.

authority.citation: Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act, Public Law 96-487, sec. 302(4), 94 Stat. 2371

designationHistory.note: Signer inferred from the date (Carter was President in December 1980). FWS documents round the area to 1.6 million acres; the act says approximately 1,430,000 acres.
